name: Maze Maker & Explorer
description: Create reproducible orthogonal mazes, resume local progress, and export monochrome puzzles with separate answer pages.
title: Maze workshop

functions.apply: Generate a puzzle or apply a legal action

generate.title: Create & reproduce
generate.portHint: Positions start at 1: top/bottom count from the left; left/right count from the top. Entrance and exit must be different cells.
generate.seedHint: Leave empty for a new puzzle
generate.codeHint: Paste an M1 code to restore dimensions, ports and seed. Play starts again at the entrance.
generate.limits: 2–40 cells per side, up to 1,600 cells; two-second generation limit. Size and route length are facts, not difficulty ratings.

board.label: Maze board: use arrow keys or click adjacent cells
board.keys: Click the board, then use arrow keys or adjacent cells. One move per key press; holding a key does not repeat. The dot is your position; S is start, E is exit.

actions.undo: Go back one move (undo its count)

confirm.answerHint: This records that the answer was viewed. Hiding it or undoing a move will not erase that record.
confirm.replaceHint: Only one maze is saved. This replaces the puzzle or clears its position, trail, hints and score. Cancel to keep the current progress.

notice.blocked: Move blocked: choose a connected adjacent cell. Invalid moves do not count.
notice.finished: Exit reached. Undo a move to continue or create another puzzle.
notice.undo: One move undone. Hint and answer-use records remain.

empty.title: Explore a maze of your own
empty.hint: Create a puzzle on the left or paste a reproduction code. Progress is saved in ToolForge’s local database so you can resume later.

paper.hint: Monochrome A4 vectors; up to 12 puzzles and 24 pages. The first matches the current puzzle; later ones use fixed batch seeds. Previewing the combined set shows puzzles only. Requesting answer preview/export records answer use. For single PNG/SVG choose puzzles or answers only.
paper.noSpoiler: The default preview has no answer. Your play trail is never printed.

help: Generate orthogonal grids with 2–40 cells per side. Every puzzle is checked independently for connectivity, no cycles, and distinct entrance/exit cells. Port positions start at 1.

An empty seed makes a new puzzle. The full M1 reproduction code contains algorithm version, dimensions, ports and seed. Paste it to restart the same puzzle under the same version; its ID is derived from those parameters.

Focus the board and use arrow keys or click neighboring cells. Walls, diagonal moves, teleports and boundary exits do not count. Held keys do not repeat. Undo removes the last valid move while retaining hint counts and answer-use facts.

Hints give a legal next step toward the exit from the current position without moving. Full answers must be requested; answer-sheet preview/export also records assistance. Finishing captures the score at that moment. Viewing answers afterward does not rewrite it; undoing and finishing again records a new score.

One puzzle is saved using ToolForge SQLite, including position, full move history and display preferences. The screen updates only after storage acknowledgement; failed writes retain prior progress and can be retried. Restart/replacement needs confirmation. No separate database or automatic history trimming.

Paper and screen share wall coordinates. A4 PDF supports 1/2/4 puzzles per page, up to 12 puzzles and 24 pages, with matching question/answer IDs and dashed monochrome routes. PNG has a 1,600-pixel longest edge; SVG/PDF are vectors. Generation/export can be cancelled. Limits: 50,000 moves, 100,000 hints, 64 MiB export; excess is rejected explicitly.

errors.maze.port: Port position is outside its edge.
errors.maze.same_port: Entrance and exit must be different cells.
errors.maze.size: Use integer rows/columns from 2 to 40 and integer port positions.
errors.maze.seed: Seeds must contain 1–80 UTF-8 bytes without control characters.
errors.maze.code: Invalid reproduction code. Paste the complete M1 code.
errors.maze.disconnected: Maze connectivity and unique paths could not be verified. No puzzle was saved.
errors.maze.time: Generation time budget exceeded. Reduce grid or batch size.
errors.maze.state: Saved identity, moves or hints are invalid. Existing data was not overwritten.
errors.maze.confirm: Restarting or replacing a puzzle needs confirmation.
errors.maze.limits: Move, hint, revision or export limit reached. Nothing was automatically trimmed.
errors.maze.paper: Invalid paper options: up to 12 puzzles, 1/2/4 per page. PNG/SVG support one puzzle and one sheet type.
errors.maze.export: Could not produce the export file.
errors.maze.answer_confirm: Record answer use before requesting answer content.
errors.maze.format: Only PDF, PNG and SVG exports are supported.
errors.maze.operation: Could not start the action. Retry.
errors.maze.busy: Wait for the current action to finish.
errors.maze.stale: Progress changed. The stale result was not saved. Reload to continue.

draw.summary: Generate a maze as text art plus a code you can import in the app; the same settings and seed always give the same maze
draw.seed: Seed; defaults to one based on the current time
draw.entrance: Side of the entrance (its first cell)
draw.exit: Side of the exit (its last cell)
